items.docs:
Runs a custom report against the reporting warehouse with caller-supplied parameters.

**Notes:** Call `GET /reports/meta` first to discover available tables and columns.

params.name: advertiserId
params.description: Advertiser identifier whose reporting metadata will be returned.

items.docs:
Returns available tables, columns, and metadata for the requesting advertiser.

**Filters:** `advertiserId`, `tables` (repeatable).

params.description: Comma-separated or repeated status filter (QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED).

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of recent batch jobs for the advertiser.

**Filters:** `advertiserId`, `status` (comma-separated or repeated).

items.docs:
Queues an asynchronous CSV export for the advertiser. Returns a `batchId` immediately;
poll `GET /reports/batch/:batchId` until `SUCCEEDED`, then use the signed `downloadUrl`.

params.name: advertiserId
params.description: Advertiser identifier owning the batch export.

items.docs: Returns batch status. When `SUCCEEDED` and within retention, a freshly-signed `downloadUrl` is included; clients should not treat the URL as stable.

params.description: Advertiser identifier owning the batch export.
